$$ \begin{cases}x+\frac{k}{x-a}=\left(x-a\right)+\frac{k}{\left(x-a\right)}+a\\x+\frac{k}{mx-a}=\frac{\left(mx-a\right)}{m}+\frac{k}{\left(mx-a\right)}+\frac{a}{m}\end{cases} $$

(2) 双变量观察分母：

$$ \begin{cases}2a+3b+\frac{1}{a+b}+\frac{1}{a+2b}=a+b+\frac{1}{a+b}+a+2b+\frac{1}{a+2b}\\ \frac{a}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}=\frac{a+b-b}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}=\frac{a+b}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}-1\\ \frac{3b+2a}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}=\frac{b+2b+2a}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}=1+\frac{2\left(a+b\right)}{b}+\frac{b}{a+b}\\ a+\frac{1}{a-b}+\frac{1}{a+b}=a-b+\frac{1}{a-b}+a+b+\frac{1}{a+b}\end{cases} $$
